postThread.author: Yaw Darko
postThread.text: The part about writing the README before the code changed how I work. Did you keep that up after launch?

replies.author: Ama Mensah
replies.text: Mostly! The README is still the first file I touch. If I can’t explain it there, the API isn’t ready.

replies.author: Esi Ofori
replies.text: Stealing this. We do it backwards at work and it shows.

replies.author: Yaw Darko
replies.text: Same here. Writing the README first would have saved us a rewrite.

replies.author: Kofi Agyeman
replies.text: How long was it from the first commit to the launch?

replies.author: Ama Mensah
replies.text: About ten weeks of evenings. The last two were all docs and examples.

postThread.author: Efua Addo
postThread.text: What actually brought people in? Hacker News, X, or something else?

replies.author: Ama Mensah
replies.text: One honest launch post, then answering every issue within a day. That did more than any launch.

replies.author: Kwame Owusu
replies.text: Quick replies are underrated. It’s why I stuck with the last library I tried.
